faq.title: Common questions about roofing projects
faq.description: Here are the questions we hear most often from homeowners planning repairs or replacements.

items.question: Do you offer emergency repairs?
items.answer: Yes. We respond quickly to active leaks and storm-related damage whenever possible.

items.question: How do I know if I need a roof replacement?
items.answer: We evaluate age, condition, previous repairs, and visible damage to recommend the best path forward.

items.question: Can you help with insurance claims?
